# Sai Teja (tejalogs)

> AI content strategist and growth marketer based in Vijayawada, India. Founder of The Social Algorithm.

Sai Teja (online as tejalogs) is an AI content strategist and growth marketer in Vijayawada, India, and the founder of The Social Algorithm (thesocialalgorithm.work). Sai Teja is also a self-made software developer. He pairs growth strategy with engineering: he doesn't just design blueprints for digital growth, he builds the autonomous engines that execute them. His work sits at the intersection of human psychology, LLM systems, and agentic automation.

## Expertise

- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and AI Engine Optimization (AIO)

- LLM search visibility and brand mention strategy
